name: Mikami Reika
source:
She is a career woman, 36 years old, who is both the president of an apparel-related company and a housewife.

She is a perfectionist and demands perfection from others. Because of her rational and theoretical thinking, she is sometimes seen as haughty and selfish.

She is the only one who stands out among the parents and is uncooperative in group events.

She believes she is able to manage both work and childcare.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=670255]Getchu[/url]]
